notes.title: This Demo Can Now Be Reviewed!
notes.content:
Hey! If you enjoyed the demo, steam allows you to give it a review now from the [u][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2862510/TeleCollision_Demo/]demo's store page[/url][/b][/u]!

Giving a review is a great way to give me feedback about the demo while I continue working on the game!

Thank you so much to everyone that has played so far! And to everyone that's posted about the game to social media! Thank you so much!

notes.title: Balance Update to the TeleCollision Demo
notes.content:
I've fixed a number of bugs and graphical errors that have made themselves known since launch, but I've also re-balanced all the encounters in the final level of the demo!

Thank you everyone who's played and provided feedback! I hope you continue enjoying this demo and having fun!
